dialogue_texts: A grand performance in the dead of night? Let us see if your presentation lives up to the stage.
I'm now laughing at you, pathetic lunarian empress.
Coming from someone hiding in the shadows of a stolen night, your laughter lacks true majesty.
You defeated my twin sister without even guessing the truth!
But when a butterfly flutters too close to the flame, its intentions matter very little once it burns.
Now that I'm mad because you freed my princess...
Both you and Fusana will be cursed to serve the Order and me!
Cursing an immortal? How delightfully naive.
Eternity has a way of outliving any minor grievance you call the Order.
I will give you a special reward for defeating my twin sister, and you will love it.
I have collected the rarest treasures of this world.
My dear, sweet, beautiful sister will be avenged!
I highly doubt you possess anything capable of catching my eye.
